errors.text: The proposed refractory-element or TiC addition does not reconstruct the target intervention of high-energy ball milling followed by spark plasma sintering.
The stated room-temperature, atmospheric conditions omit the essential milling and SPS parameters.
TiC is incorrectly grouped with Hf as a refractory element rather than identified as a ceramic reinforcement.
The prediction omits the target quantitative hardness, compressive strength, yield stress, density, phase fractions, and nanocrystalline grain size.
The cited studies concern substantially different alloy systems and do not establish retention of favorable plasticity or machinability in CoCrFeNiTi.
